theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (c : Euclid n) (r m : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ ball c r, ∀ b ∈ ball c r, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖) → ∀ z ∈ ball c r, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (g '' ball c r) (g z) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
